lines.text: An owner clears the stones from a fertile hill, plants the finest vines, and builds a watchtower.
He digs out a well and waits for good grapes, but the vineyard produces sour fruit.
The owner asks the people of Jerusalem and Judah to judge between him and his vineyard.
He will tear down its wall, make it a wasteland of thorns, and command the clouds to withhold rain.
The vineyard of the LORD of Hosts is the house of Egypt, and He looked for justice but saw bloodshed.
